spans.label: plonky2, Transfer and transfer-tree imports
spans.note: Semantics comes from an imported crate/gadget/hash; modelled as an opaque callback or premise. Transfer leaf layout is transcribed from src/common/transfer.rs; the tree and hash stay opaque.

spans.label: TransferWitnessError enum
spans.note: Handwritten local semantics; no source/compiler refinement. thiserror Display formatting is not modelled.

spans.label: TransferWitness struct fields
spans.note: Handwritten local semantics; no source/compiler refinement. The transfer leaf and the settled-transfer nullifier preimage are transcribed alongside the witness fields.

spans.label: TransferWitness::new
spans.note: Handwritten local semantics; no source/compiler refinement. `new` assembles, verifies and returns the arguments unchanged.

spans.label: TransferWitness::verify (single Merkle opening, no index range check)
spans.note: Handwritten local semantics; no source/compiler refinement. The absence of any native index bound is recorded, using the BitPath truncation premise.

spans.label: TransferWitnessTarget struct fields
spans.note: Handwritten local semantics; no source/compiler refinement. The target struct is represented by the gate predicate over the same fields.

spans.label: TransferWitnessTarget::new (allocation, 6-bit index range check, opening)
spans.note: Handwritten local semantics; no source/compiler refinement. Range checks are a declarative table; note that token_index gets no bound here.

spans.label: TransferWitnessTarget::set_witness
spans.note: Handwritten local semantics; no source/compiler refinement. Only the order in which fields are written is modelled.

spans.label: closing brace
spans.note: No executable constraint is inferred from comments or blank lines.

boundaries.name: merkle-opening
boundaries.obligation: IncrementalMerkleProof::verify over the transfer tree and its target counterpart are opaque decision callbacks.

boundaries.name: merkle-index-truncation
boundaries.obligation: MerkleEnv.truncates is transcribed from BitPath::pop rather than proved about the Rust code; the index-aliasing theorem depends on it.

boundaries.name: transfer-leaf-layout
boundaries.obligation: Transfer / SettledTransfer word layouts are transcribed from src/common/transfer.rs by hand, not derived from that file's own model.

boundaries.name: poseidon-hash
boundaries.obligation: The settled-transfer nullifier calls an opaque Poseidon callback; no collision resistance is established.

boundaries.name: plonky2-gate-lowering
boundaries.obligation: No proof that TransferWitnessGates corresponds to the constraints TransferWitnessTarget::new emits, including split_le's implicit index decomposition.

boundaries.name: transfer-token-index-bound
boundaries.obligation: TransferTarget::new emits no range check on token_index; any bound must come from callers and is not established here.
